description: Words of the query that are different names of ONE category (issue 25941): the category stays with the most general name, the other words are words of a name. 'Friedhofskapelle Church' and 'Kirche Friedhofskapelle' (en app on a de map: 'church' is en, 'Kirche' and 'friedhofskapelle' are de phrases of religion_christian) list the chapels named Friedhofskapelle, not every church and not the category row. 'Church Chapel' (both en): a church named Chapel (name:en 'Peace Chapel'). A single phrase of the map ('Friedhofskapelle') and the words of one name ('Place of worship') stay the category; two different categories of one object ('Vegan Restaurant') are not touched. The same in the de app (phrase setting phrasesLang de): 'Kirche' and 'friedhofskapelle' are both names of religion_christian of the translator, 'Kirche' is listed first in phrases.xml and stays the category whatever the order of the words; 'Kirche' alone is the category.
